description: Kinetic parameters for the first GaN growth-regime model (src/mbe_twin/growth.py): Ga-polar (0001) GaN, plasma-assisted MBE. Literature values with their sources and conditions; none is fitted to this machine. Temperatures in the sources are each lab's substrate-temperature readings, not the proposed machine's wafer temperature (ref/notes/GROWTH_EVIDENCE.md, correction 5).

units.ml_definition: one GaN(0001) monolayer (surface site density 1.14e15 cm^-2; c/2 = 0.259 nm)

decomposition.source: G02, Eq. (3) and Fig. 3: GaN decomposition in vacuum from QMS and RHEED
decomposition.validity: 720-805 C substrate reading; literature activation energies 3.1-3.6 eV (G02 refs 7, 8, 10, 11)
decomposition.under_ga_rich_growth: equal to the vacuum rate (G02 Figs. 4-5, slightly Ga-rich)
decomposition.under_n_rich_growth: reduced by active-N excess, no law given (G02 Fig. 4); bracketed between 0 and the vacuum rate

droplet_onset.description: Critical Ga flux F_crit = prefactor * exp(-energy / kT) in ML/s at the onset of Ga droplet accumulation. The sources disagree by up to two orders of magnitude in prefactor and 2.3 eV in energy; they are kept as scenarios, not averaged.

G01_adsorption.kind: Ga flux without N (adsorption phase diagram, 2->3 transition)

Heying_growth.kind: excess Ga flux during growth at N flux 0.28 ML/s
Heying_growth.source: G01 Table I, Ref. 17 2->3 (as tabulated by G01)

Ref14_growth.kind: excess Ga flux during growth at N flux 1.1 ML/s
Ref14_growth.source: G01 Table I, Ref. 14 2->3 (as tabulated by G01)

droplet_onset.cross_check: R20: at 700 C and N flux 4.8 nm/min the desorbing Ga equals the excess (Phi_Ga - Phi_N) up to an excess of about 5 nm/min, the droplet onset (R20 Fig. 1 discussion)
droplet_onset.cross_check_R32: R32 (Zhang et al. 2026, arXiv 2605.22279): Ga adlayer desorption without N, rate constant 0.118 / 0.068 / 0.04 s^-1 at 708 / 693 / 676 C with a 2.4 ML maximum adlayer, Ea 2.87 +/- 0.04 eV. Maximum adlayer desorption flux 0.28 / 0.16 / 0.10 ML/s, against the scenarios at 708 C: G01 0.13, Heying 0.22, Ref14 0.41 ML/s. Inside the scenario range at 708 C; its slope matches Ref14_growth (2.8 eV), and the 4.8-5.1 eV scenarios lie 1.3-5x below it over 676-708 C. Not added as a scenario: it sits inside the range, it has no N flux, and its temperatures are pyrometer readings through a Ti back coating (emissivity assumed 0.55). Recorded 2026-10-06; ref/notes/RESEARCH_GAP_SEARCH_2026-10-06.md.

adlayer.source: G01 abstract and Sec. III (region 2: 2.5 +/- 0.2 ML laterally contracted Ga bilayer)
adlayer.steady_state_time_source: R20: steady-state growth and desorption within the first 10-20 s of a growth pulse

growth_modes.note: R20's growth-mode map (3D / layer-by-layer / step-flow versus Ga flux and temperature) holds for N flux 4.8 nm/min on one template; boundary fluxes at 750 / 780 C are about 3 / 2 nm/min (3D -> layer-by-layer) and 7.5 / 11 nm/min (-> step-flow). Recorded for regime checks, not used as model parameters.
